items.title: Hybrid Knowledge in the Early East India Company World
items.note: Traces Company servants who gathered medical and botanical knowledge from Asian practitioners and sent it to Petiver and Sloane.

items.title: William Courten's lists of 'Things Bought' from the late seventeenth century
items.venue: Journal of the History of Collections
items.note: Edits Courten's acquisition lists with dates, prices and sellers, giving a documentary control for material that later entered Sloane's catalogues, including several unnamed suppliers.

items.title: Exploring cultures of collecting in the early modern world
items.who: A. Marples and V. R. M. Pickering
items.note: Uses Sloane's Chinese drug collection in Vegetable Substances to discuss how local medical knowledge entered London collections through intermediaries.

items.title: Putting nature in a box: Hans Sloane's 'Vegetable Substances' collection
items.venue: PhD thesis, Queen Mary University of London
items.note: First full study of the Vegetable Substances catalogue and its suppliers, using Sloane's correspondence to reconstruct the networks behind the entries.

items.title: Secret Cures of Slaves: People, Plants, and Medicine in the Eighteenth-Century Atlantic World
items.note: Studies medical exchange among Africans, Amerindians and Europeans in the Caribbean, including colonial purchases of remedies from enslaved healers.

items.title: Collecting the World: Hans Sloane and the Origins of the British Museum
items.note: Biography placing Sloane's collecting within slavery and empire and discussing the largely anonymous presence of enslaved and colonized people in his records.

items.title: The Age of Intoxication: Origins of the Global Drug Trade
items.note: Follows drugs from African, Asian and American settings into Portuguese and English apothecary and scientific networks.

items.title: The Collectors: Creating Hans Sloane's Extraordinary Herbarium
items.note: Biographical entries for the people who supplied Sloane's herbarium, a reference list for matching suppliers named in Vegetable Substances; link is to a review.

items.title: Enlightenment architectures: the reconstruction of Sir Hans Sloane's cabinets of 'Miscellanies'
items.venue: Journal of the History of Collections
items.note: Reconstructs the Miscellanies catalogue and links some objects to Courten's purchases, a model for tying catalogue entries to acquisition documents.

items.title: 'I have been obliged to Send Nassaw': an enslaved healer's medical labour and skill in eighteenth-century Virginia
items.note: Reconstructs a named enslaved healer's practice from plantation correspondence and cautions against inferring origins from names.

items.title: Sealed and concealed: the uses of Hans Sloane's collection of 'Vegetable Substances'
items.venue: Journal of the History of Collections
items.note: Examines how the Vegetable Substances were stored, catalogued and used, and what the catalogue does and does not record about sources.

items.title: Hans Sloane and the Melancholy Slave
items.venue: Early Modern Trauma (University of Nebraska Press)
items.note: Reads Sloane's Jamaican case histories of enslaved patients, part of the clinical setting in which he gathered and recorded African medical practice.

items.title: The Sloane Lab: Looking back to build future shared collections
items.who: J. Nyhan et al. (UCL, British Museum, NHM)
items.note: AHRC Discovery Project AH/W003457/1, October 2021 to September 2024, to relink Sloane's dispersed catalogues and collections.

items.title: Hans Sloane's Collection of Vegetables and Vegetable Substances
items.who: V. Pickering, C. Jarvis and M. Carine (Natural History Museum)
items.note: Open transcription of the whole Vegetable Substances catalogue with named suppliers, places and links to surviving specimens, making a corpus-wide attribution count possible.

items.title: A Guide to Finding Women in the Sloane Lab Knowledge Base
items.note: Research guide and dataset showing how to recover women suppliers and intermediaries across Sloane's linked catalogues, a template for other under-recorded contributors.

items.title: Final Report - Sloane Lab: Looking Back to Build Future Shared Collections
items.who: J. Nyhan, A. Vlachidis, A. Flinn, N. Pearlman, M. Carine et al.
items.note: Reports the Sloane Lab Knowledge Base, a CIDOC CRM knowledge graph linking Sloane's historical catalogues to British Museum, NHM and British Library records.

items.title: Collecting and cataloguing the world: the botanical collections of Hans Sloane (1660–1753)
items.who: B. Scott, V. Pickering, R. Coulton, J. Nyhan and M. Carine
items.note: Counts suppliers across the herbarium and Vegetable Substances, reports further Courten labels and warns about composite entries and catalogue attributions.

items.title: Hans Sloane's Collection of Vegetables and Vegetable Substances (updated release)
items.note: Revised release of the catalogue dataset, with about 12,750 rows and object links for surviving specimens.
